explanation.en: Iterating over a file yields one line at a time. readlines() instead collects all remaining lines into a list. Each line usually keeps its trailing newline.
explanation.nl: Over een bestand loopen levert telkens één regel. readlines() verzamelt alle resterende regels in een list. Elke regel behoudt meestal het afsluitende regeleinde.

solution.main.py:
with open("log.txt", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    lines = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in handle]
print(lines)

task.en: Read log.txt and create lines containing each line without its trailing newline.
